maddeler.e:
احتجمن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَمْنَ (iḥtajamna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# اُحْتُجِمْنَ (uḥtujimna) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# اِحْتَجِمْنَ (iḥtajimna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
